github: one page of up to 100 oldest created (then issue number if ordering ties; order at provider); is:issue word in:title repo and window. No PRs. Other trackers analogously when verified, date/term rechecked locally. Search-enriched convenience frame, not prevalence.
sample: Exclude title/body matching security/sensitive patterns in script before writing. Dedupe canonical URL, collapse canonical issue and overlapping terms, disjoint assignment earliest matching retrieval stratum in protocol term order. Sort SHA256('E9-v1|'+canonical URL) within tracker x term. Round robin queues in listed tracker then term order, taking 1 per nonempty cell per pass, until 300. No replacements conditioned on annotation. Missing trackers reported separately; partial if unavailable. No speculative duplicates across tickets. Label packet only blind id, title, URL; assess independently from linked evidence. Do not label until acquisition closed.
